title: App bindings companion (app-bindings/v1)
description: A versioned, data-only companion to app-views/v1: it maps view ids the descriptor declares onto a closed set of host read sources (customers, caption-runs) and closed read ops (list, show), and per descriptor field id a dotted key into that source's fixed projection plus the descriptor format the host renders it with. The file is data, never behaviour — keys that name executable surfaces, URLs or navigation, scope or actor identity, credentials, storage internals, authority claims, or any invocation vocabulary (method/call/rpc/tool/command/exec/args/binding/connection/account/slot/request/fetch/body/params/where/order_by/limit/cursor/write/update/delete/send/approve/dispatch/run_id/artifact/artifacts/snapshot/record/store/migration) are forbidden at every level and are enforced by the consumer's recursive scan; this schema additionally forbids them at each object's `propertyNames`. Identifier grammar is [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}; a field `key` is one or more dot-separated segments of that grammar. Consumers must also enforce the bounds and cross-references documented here (unique view bindings, ops usable by the view's kind, fields naming declared descriptor fields, formats the produced shape can fill, enum domains equal to the produced domain) — JSON Schema alone cannot express them.

contract.description: The contract tag. A binding file naming any other version is refused.

app.description: The workspace-app kind this binding was reviewed with — must equal the bundle's `app` (manifest) and the descriptor's `app`. Provenance only — never an installation id, route, or authority claim.

title.description: Human title for the binding file — plain text.

bindings.description: Per-view bindings; `view` ids unique within the file (consumer-checked) and each must name a declared table/detail view in the companion descriptor.

field.description: Must equal a field id declared on the bound view in the companion descriptor (consumer-checked).

key.description: Dotted path into the source's fixed projection (e.g. display_name, consent.email, snapshot.workflow.title). Must be a member of the source's reviewed key table (consumer-checked).

format.description: Must equal the descriptor field's `format` and be a format the produced shape can fill (consumer-checked): list-shaped sources only via `tags`, consent/run-state enums only via `enum`, integer timestamps only via `number` or `datetime`.

view.description: The descriptor view id this binding serves. Only `table` and `detail` views may be bound — a `form` view is a disabled preview and can never carry a binding (consumer-checked).

source.description: The closed set of host read sources. `customers` reads the record store's CustomerProfile; `caption-runs` reads the run row's metadata-only surface.

ops.description: The read operations this binding admits; `list` is a table's op, `show` a detail's (consumer-checked).

fields.description: Per-field projection; `field` ids unique within the binding (consumer-checked).
